tools.name: find_location
tools.description: Finds cities and airports by name or IATA/ICAO code and returns a ref for each. The other Mirai Flights tools take places as refs; a city ref covers all of the city's airports.

tools.name: get_charter_option
tools.description: Returns details and the booking link for one option from search_charter. Booking happens on mirai.flights or in the Mirai app.

tools.name: get_charter_results
tools.description: Returns the options collected so far for an unfinished search_charter call, by its task_id.

tools.name: get_empty_leg
tools.description: Returns details, the price for a given number of passengers and the booking link for one empty leg. Booking happens on mirai.flights or in the Mirai app.

tools.name: list_aircraft_classes
tools.description: Lists aircraft classes (light, midsize, heavy and more) with example types; ids filter charter and empty leg searches.

tools.name: search_charter
tools.description: Prices a private jet charter for a route of 1-5 legs (a round trip is 2 legs) with Mirai Flights operators. Returns options sorted by price, each with suggestion_id and company_id for get_charter_option. Operators answer for up to 40 seconds; complete is false when more options can be fetched with g

tools.name: search_empty_legs
tools.description: Searches empty leg flights: discounted one-way repositioning flights that depart within a time window. All filters are optional. Each result has id and company_id for get_empty_leg.
